docs.title: About Me
docs.text:
I am a Master's student in Geospatial Information Sciences program at the University of Maryland - College Park, with a background in Statistics. I had over two years of experience as a data analyst at the World Bank Group, where I supported research, data analysis, and client advisory work.

I’m passionate about using spatial data to uncover local climate risks and environmental inequities that big national averages tend to hide, making sure data-driven evidence can lead to better policy. (Check out my spotlight feature to learn a bit more about my path!)

Outside of school and work, you can usually find me running, baking and enjoying all-you-can-eat hot pot.

docs.title: Analyst — World Bank Group Treasury, Advisory & Knowledge
docs.text:
October 2023 – May 2026 | Washington, DC

  • Research: Led quantitative analysis on biodiversity loss and sovereign bond yields across 34 economies using fixed-effects GMM, identifying biodiversity risk as a measurable factor in sovereign risk pricing. Contributed to a 21-year empirical study on sustainable portfolio optimization, with findings acknowledged in Bouyé, Deguest & Jurczenko, "Biodiversity and Climate: Friends or Foes?" (Sustainable Finance Alliance, 2024).
  • Data Management: Managed end-to-end data collection, validation, and reconciliation for global knowledge products including the 2025 RAMP Survey, delivering standardized datasets across 130+ institutions worldwide.
  • Dashboard Development: Built and automated Power BI and SAP-integrated dashboards to track learning outcomes for 10,000+ training participants and support monthly resource allocation and annual planning reviews.
  • Advisory Support: Conducted institutional peer benchmarking and geospatial capacity gap analysis, producing briefs and presentations that directly supported senior economists in advisory missions and strategic planning initiatives.
  • Capacity Building: Designed and delivered technical programming workshops to 100+ professionals from central banks, trust funds, and international partner institutions.

docs.title: Summer Intern — World Bank Group Treasury, Rotational Program
docs.text:
May 2023 – September 2023 | Washington, DC

  • Climate Risk Analysis: Consolidated four major climate risk indices (ND-GAIN, CCPI, EPI, Germanwatch CRI) in Python into a single harmonized dataset, enabling systematic comparison of climate adaptation indicators across countries.
  • Policy Research: Produced a technical report on Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) developments across the Asia-Pacific region.
  • Risk Modeling: Built an Excel VBA model that automated access-privilege scoring, covering 70% of entitlement roles and reducing manual review time.

docs.title: Research Assistant — George Mason University
docs.text:
June 2022 – September 2022 | Fairfax, VA

  • Built and analyzed a multi-source spatial dataset using machine learning (XGBoost) and regression methods (OLS, MGWR) to identify 18 social determinants of breast cancer mortality across US counties, achieving strong explanatory power (adjusted R² = 0.50).
  • Findings contributed to a peer-reviewed publication in JAMA Network Open — see Publications below.

docs.title: Data Science Teaching Assistant — George Mason University
docs.text:
January 2022 – May 2023 | Fairfax, VA

  • Supported 200 students across advanced Data Science courses in SQL, MATLAB, R, regression modeling, and applied statistics.
  • Developed exam solutions, grading rubrics, and contributed to course redesign to improve clarity and student outcomes.
